Each valid ballot chose one of three answers: the initiative (column 'Initiative Ja', yes.0), no change (column 'Initiative Nein', no.0, which the article calls 'Belassung des bisherigen Zustandes'), or the Landtag's counter-proposal (column 'Landtagsvorschlag Ja', yes.1); the three add up to the valid ballots, so yes.0 + no.0 does not equal valid.

The paper prints no Oberland or Unterland totals; the unlabeled national total row is recorded as Liechtenstein. 'Total abgegeb. Stimmen' is recorded as cards, 'gültige Stimmzettel' as valid, dashes as 0.

Each ballot chose one of three answers: yes to the initiative, no to it, or yes to the Landtag's counter-proposal; the three add up to the valid ballots, so the archive keeps them as one question with three answers.
